method: CIE76 ΔE: sRGB → linear RGB → CIE XYZ D65 → Lab; compute the Euclidean distance at each matching pixel and average only where BOTH alpha values are 255. No alignment, resizing, compositing, or background pixels enter the metric. N is the number of shared opaque pixels. Shape differences are deliberately not scored. These numbers are a guide, never a threshold; judge the 16 px strips first.
